# Fictional fixtures only

All people, organizations, token policies, quotations and source metadata in these files are invented. `example.org` URLs are placeholders, not collected evidence. The repeated hexadecimal source digest is also a placeholder, not a hash of a retrieved artifact.

`base.json` is a private-schema-shaped **fictional test dataset**, marked `fixture: true` and draft. It has three thematic modules. `extension.json` is an append-only collection fragment adding another fictional person and a fourth module/question; tests combine it with the base without changing code or the existing data. Synthetic test approvals are created only in test memory and never count as human approval. No fixture output may be published.
